Subject: SIG - subprocessor breakdown (cloud, telemetry, support)

Hi Ben,

We're kicking off the SIG review for our enterprise agreement and need a current list of Redwood's subprocessors that touch production customer data. Specifically we need: cloud infra providers (including regions), telemetry/observability vendors, support tools (ticketing, chat), and any managed services used for backups or logging.

Could you provide a one-page inventory and any evidence artifacts you typically share (attestation PDFs, CSV roster, SOC2 references)? Our procurement team prefers a CSV roster + a PDF snapshot for audit intake. If you have a canonical link or a single file that maps vendors -> data category -> purpose -> contract owner, that would speed review.

Target timeline: we'd like the initial inventory by EOD Monday (2027-01-11) to stay on our procurement schedule. Also note we'll ask for assurance on data egress and telemetry routing for EU-sourced traffic (may follow up with a scoped question set).

Thanks,
Kara Lewis

Hi Kara / Tom — thanks for the clarifying questions. Laura prepared the attached artifacts and I included a short CSV with direct links into our secure evidence Drive. Summary answers inline below and attached: redwood_subprocessors_snapshot_202701.pdf, sig-evidence-matrix-202701.csv

1) Telemetry: Observix is a managed aggregator. Raw logs containing any customer PII are routed first to Observix, which performs ingestion/normalization, then a redaction step filters PII before metrics are stored in our analytics blob. We have a Data Processing Addendum with Observix (attached reference).

2) Support tools: We use Zendesk for ticketing; transcripts are persisted per customer account. Customers can request deletion and we have an internal workflow that triggers data removal and records it in the ticket metadata. Deletion requests are handled via our Privacy team; process doc link included in the CSV evidence_link.

3) CSV links: the attached CSV has direct, read-only Drive links to the supporting PDFs and attestation notes (column: evidence_link). If you prefer signed PDFs instead of Drive links we can generate those; let us know.

If you want a 30 minute sync, Laura and I are available Tuesday 9:00-11:00 PT. Otherwise we can continue asynchronously.

Thanks —
